lead_headline: Restaurant tracker back online after 25-day outage—6 new leads today include BARna Global Soccer opening Colfax, Ichigo Matcha third location near DU

restaurant.blurb: 6 new leads today—BARna Global Soccer & Tapas opens 10,000 sq ft Colfax sports bar, Ichigo Matcha lands third location near DU, Blazing Bird takes former 7-Eleven on East Colfax. City Park West, University, Globeville neighborhoods active.

liquor.blurb: Zero new applications today—Thursday extends post-weekend dormancy to fifth consecutive day as system remains frozen following Saturday's 350-application backlog dump. 7-day total holds at 369, all from June 14's mass clearance that followed two-week shutdown. Denver Post, Instagram, and Facebook drove prior-week citations; current 369-application spike represents outlier processing event rather than sustained trend, with Sun-Thu void (5 days, 0 apps) suggesting return to pre-weekend baseline. No status changes as mid-month quiet period continues.

reputation.blurb: 1 mention yesterday—Thursday collapses from Wednesday's 9-citation recovery, dragging 7-day total to 43 mentions across 15 sources, down 10% from prior week's 48. Denver Post dominates week with 14 citations (33% of volume), covering RiNo cafe lease, Flywheel Yale bankruptcy, criminal case dismissals. Instagram and Facebook tied at 6 mentions each, Reddit contributed 4. Week's sharp downturn from mid-week rebound signals return to Jun 16-17's lull pattern, threatening to push monthly total (202) below typical Q2 velocity as final third approaches. Google News RSS remains sole discovery channel.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +0 yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) marks seventh consecutive shutdown day, freezing MTD at +13 (+0.7/day) while 90-day net holds at +130. Current week's 0 net through Thursday starkly contrasts prior period's +11 through comparable Thursday, confirming June's persistent acquisition freeze extends beyond weekend dormancy into full trading week. Recent fortnight's pattern—concentrated weekday bursts (June 5: +4, June 9: +3, June 12: +3) followed by multi-day voids—now threatens MTD velocity (+0.7) falling further below YTD baseline (+1.2) as seven-day shutdown drags mid-month performance toward March lows.
